watches.name: Odyssey III (Hades)
watches.description: Hades represents the expanse of the deep unknown, where every ending marks a transition into something new. The deep black dial reflects confidence, depth of character, and the infinite possibilities within your path.

watches.name: Odyssey III (Gaia)
watches.description: Named after the earth that grounds and nourishes all living things, Gaia is an anchor to our origins. Its rich brown hue serves as a reminder to remain steadfast and true to your roots, no matter how far you travel.

watches.name: Odyssey III (Horizon)
watches.description: Horizon sits where open waters meet the vast expanse of sky. Its fresh turquoise tone evokes the quiet optimism of looking out toward uncharted shores and setting course for new ground.

watches.name: Odyssey III (Ember)
watches.description: Ember draws from the steady warmth of basecamp fires and the inner drive that keeps us moving forward. The deep crimson dial speaks passion, resilience, and the spark behind every new beginning.

watches.name: Odyssey III (Solstice)
watches.description: Solstice marks the longest day of the year, when sunlight lingers and harvest begins. Its warm golden tone captures a moment of pause, celebration, and gratitude for how far the journey has come.

watches.name: Odyssey III (Zenith)
watches.description: Named after the highest point in the sky, Zenith represents absolute clarity and hard-won milestones. Its clean white dial reflects the bright light found at the peak of a long ascent, reminding you of where you stand and what lies ahead.

watches.name: Intervallum Consistens
watches.description: Consistens is a play on the word “Consistent,” evoking an unwavering dedication to unchanging excellence. In any instance or condition, Consistens exudes its signature DNA of reliability and accuracy, drawing inspiration from the famed Le Mans racer Derek Bell. Consistens is seen with the iconic blue and orange, hues synonymous with heritage, elegance, and speed.

watches.name: Intervallum Verstante
watches.description: Verstante is a portmanteau of “Verge” meaning edge, and “Tante” meaning much. Combined, Verstante evokes a spirit of driving on the absolute edge, with a passion stemming from Formula 1 racer Ayrton Senna – the inspiration for this model. Verstante is made following the colors of green, yellow, and blue – reflecting the brand’s vibrance and its passion to step forward to the edge.

watches.name: Asteri 2.0 (Dreamer's Pink)
watches.description: Dreamer’s Pink represents the hope ticking quietly forward. A color between the pureness of white and the energy of red, pink is slow passion and peace – a color of transition and hope. Dreamer’s Pink perfectly complements the Asteri, presenting a time in motion towards a hopeful future for the Philippines.

watches.name: Asteri 2.0 (Regal Purple)
watches.description: Regal Purple represents the past – of the Philippines’ wealth in culture, community, and celebration rooted in time-honored tradition. Purple was once used to adorn old leaders, or “Datus” to symbolize their status, power, and influence. This regal purple is translated as a homage to the country’s past – giving emphasis to its majesty and resilience.

watches.name: Odyssey 2.0 (Burgundy)
watches.description: A tribute to Renaissance scholars, the Odyssey 2.0 in Burgundy features a deep sunburst dial symbolizing intellect, refinement, and legacy. With luminous BGW9-applied indices, a 316L stainless steel case, and an NH35A automatic movement, this timepiece is engineered for the modern mind with timeless ambition.

watches.name: Odyssey 2.0 (Peach-Salmon)
watches.description: Inspired by the warmth of the artist’s hand, the Odyssey 2.0 in Peach-Salmon is a celebration of human craft and creation. Its sunburst dial evokes Renaissance flesh tones, while BGW9 lume and automatic movement ensure that this mechanical timepiece is as functional as it is beautiful.

watches.name: Odyssey 2.0 (White)
watches.description: Embodying the clarity and purity of the Age of Reason, the Odyssey 2.0 in White features a lacquered dial that reflects both elegance and simplicity. With BGW9 lume, crisp indices, and mechanical precision, it’s a watch that honors light—both intellectual and visual.

watches.name: Asteri (Sunlight White)
watches.description: A new face for every adventure. The Asteri Sunlight White joins the collection, featuring a 4x anti-reflective coating, a micro-adjustment clasp system, quick-release steel bracelets, and lumed hands and markers using the Swiss Super-LumiNova. A fine combination of brushed and polished finishes. Limited to 50 pieces, with production numbers engraved on the caseback, this is a special edition of the best Argos yet. Completing the view of Sierra Madre—lush greens, midnight skies, and now, sunlight by day. The journey continues.

watches.name: Odyssey 1.0 (Cream)
watches.description: Inspired by Homer's epic, the Odyssey combines daily ruggedness with elegance, ensuring versatility for any occasion. It is built to withstand harsh environments, guaranteeing reliability and durability. This makes the Odyssey an excellent choice for an everyday watch, perfectly blending functionality with sophisticated design.

watches.name: Odyssey 1.0 (Blue)
watches.description: Inspired by Homer's epic, the Odyssey combines daily ruggedness with elegance, ensuring versatility for any occasion. It is built to withstand harsh environments, guaranteeing reliability and durability. This makes the Odyssey an excellent choice for an everyday watch, perfectly blending functionality with sophisticated design.

watches.name: Asteri (Midnight Blue)
watches.description: Asteri, an ancient Greek word meaning ‘star,’ represents the brand’s guiding light toward its vision of establishing and elevating the Philippine watchmaking industry. The Midnight Blue dial represents the deep blues that envelop the mountain range during the tranquil night. This shade conveys a sense of serenity and mystery, capturing the atmospheric beauty of the Sierra Madre after sundown. The distinct dial faces not only reflect the changing tones of the mountainous environment but also contribute to the watch's versatile aesthetic, adapting seamlessly to various settings and occasions.

watches.name: Asteri (Forest Green)
watches.description: Asteri, an ancient Greek word meaning ‘star,’ represents the brand’s guiding light toward its vision of establishing and elevating the Philippine watchmaking industry. The Forest Green dial reflects the lush and vibrant greens of the Sierra Madre mountain range during the day. This verdant hue not only encapsulates the landscape's natural beauty but also evokes a sense of vitality and freshness. The distinct dial face not only reflect the changing tones of the mountainous environment but also contribute to the watch's versatile aesthetic, adapting seamlessly to various settings and occasions.
